FirstOnboarding.title: Welcome to FilixPay
FirstOnboarding.subtitle: Complete a few business details to activate Merchant Center and start your trial.

fields.name: Merchant name
fields.mobilePlaceholder: Enter phone number (spaces or dashes OK)
fields.officialIdHelp: Enter your Unified Social Credit Code / company registration number, or a personal ID / passport number (15–18 characters).
fields.settlementModeShort: Determines how funds are settled and your merchant account type.
fields.settlementModeNote: To use a different settlement mode, add a business account in Merchant Center.
fields.settlementCurrencyShort: Used for payouts and cross-currency conversion.
fields.settlementCurrencyHint: Settlement currency is used for payouts and cross-currency payment conversion. It cannot be changed after registration. Choose carefully.

modes.platformFlow: Customer payment → Platform collects → Platform clears & settles → Credited to your merchant account
modes.platformChannel: Uses the platform's unified payment channel configuration
modes.directFlow: Customer payment → Direct payment channel → Funds settled directly to your merchant account
modes.directChannel: Uses your merchant-owned payment channel configuration

FirstOnboarding.submit: Create merchant and enter Merchant Center

errors.mobileInvalid: Enter a valid phone number (5–20 digits)
errors.mobileInvalidIntl: Enter a valid phone number (6–15 digits)
errors.officialIdInvalid: Enter a 15–18 character official ID number
errors.duplicateName: This merchant name is already taken
errors.registrationTaken: This ID is already registered to an organization. Use another ID or join with an existing account.
errors.alreadyHasMerchant: This account already has a merchant
errors.unauthorized: Please sign in again to continue
errors.portalAuthRejected: You are signed in, but the merchant API rejected your access token. After rebuilding Keycloak, verify the merchant-center client secret matches WildFly/Next.js, restart the Java service, then sign in again.
errors.createFailed: Could not create merchant. Please try again.
errors.membershipNotReady: Merchant was created but access is not ready yet. Refresh or sign in again.
errors.orgsLoadFailed: Could not load your account context. Retry.
